items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: So I just, to this day I take those voicings that he showed me and try to you know, hear them

ctx.x: So that you can let go and not have to think too hard.

I mean let me say this, my solo piano playing is pretty much the least interesting thing I’ve ever heard. You know like you hear Ellis Marsalis sit down and play, when he was filling in for Ellis Larkin at the Carnegie Lounge in Manhattan — just wonderful, flowing lyrical, delicate, grooving, swinging stuff. And you know I hear my solo stuff back and like for instance two years ago I did a solo piano set at Newport. And you know I just didn’t feel good about it at the time.
